newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.

text.p: Turnover rose to 133,300 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 7,365 denars at the previous session on Thursday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Gradinar Loza Skopje sold 43 stocks at 3,100 denars, up 437 from previous close and above par of 2,663 denars.
Traded volume was 10 shares on Thursday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
